title: [OpenReg] Lack ofinitDeviceStreamStatein some APIs
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

The `initDeviceStreamState()` can only be called by calling `getStreamFromPool()`. And if user calls APIs like `getCurrentOpenRegStream()` or `getDefaultOpenRegStream()`, then something will failed.
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/c297b02f12f7fd33bb47447c336acc6a78738a62/test/cpp_extensions/open_registration_extension/torch_openreg/csrc/runtime/OpenRegStream.cpp#L200-L212

Common used APIs won't initiate device stream state:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/c297b02f12f7fd33bb47447c336acc6a78738a62/test/cpp_extensions/open_registration_extension/torch_openreg/csrc/runtime/OpenRegStream.cpp#L227-L242

`initDeviceStreamState()` should be in `initOpenRegState()` and the latter one is called by most OpenReg stream API that user may use.
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/c297b02f12f7fd33bb47447c336acc6a78738a62/test/cpp_extensions/open_registration_extension/torch_openreg/csrc/runtime/OpenRegStream.cpp#L140-L145
